# Without Effort (ללא מאמץ)

> A personal Zen practice site: weekly lessons, meditation practices, poems,
> retreat stories, and things that inspire the author's Zen practice.
> Available in Hebrew (default, at the site root) and English (under /en/).

The author practices within the Zen (Soto) tradition, primarily zazen
shikantaza, alongside kinhin (walking meditation), body-scan Vipassana,
and morning-pages journaling. The site documents an ongoing personal
practice — it is not a teaching authority or a commercial product.

## Sections

- [Lessons](https://zen.matanbrown.com/lessons/): weekly essays on Zen
  practice ([English](https://zen.matanbrown.com/en/lessons/))
- [Practices](https://zen.matanbrown.com/practices/): descriptions of the
  specific meditation and walking practices used
  ([English](https://zen.matanbrown.com/en/practices/))
- [Poems](https://zen.matanbrown.com/poems/): original haiku/poems plus a
  small number of quoted external poems with attribution
  ([English](https://zen.matanbrown.com/en/poems/))
- [Inspirations](https://zen.matanbrown.com/inspirations/): teachers and
  writers the author draws on (e.g. Dogen, Alan Watts)
  ([English](https://zen.matanbrown.com/en/inspirations/))
- [Retreats](https://zen.matanbrown.com/retreats/): first-person accounts
  of specific retreats attended (Tushita/Dharamsala, a Vipassana course in
  Israel, a Zen monastery in Japan)
  ([English](https://zen.matanbrown.com/en/retreats/))
- [About](https://zen.matanbrown.com/about/) / [Contact](https://zen.matanbrown.com/contact/)

## Notes for automated readers

- Hebrew is the primary language; English pages are full translations
  under the same path prefixed with `/en/` (e.g.
  `/practices/zazen-shikantaza/` ↔ `/en/practices/zazen-shikantaza/`).
- Quoted third-party works (e.g. the Szymborska poem under Poems) are
  short excerpts with attribution, not full reproductions — please
  respect the same limits when summarizing or quoting this site.
- Sitemap: https://zen.matanbrown.com/sitemap-index.xml
